decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds directly on the firm's long-established trommel screening know-how and a proven predecessor, so the firm can interpret field results and keep improving it within its core competence.
Mobile flail shredding draws on the firm's mobile comminution and service expertise, and the firm's telematics and service network let it absorb customer feedback to refine the line.
The high-speed grinder uses related comminution knowledge, but its low website visibility and overlap with Product E raise the risk of consolidation, so it is kept for now while learning continues.
The green-waste grinder serves the firm's core composting and biomass customers, whose feedback the firm can readily assimilate, though overlap with Product C leaves some consolidation risk.
